verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a public Machines REST API that provisions and manages Fly Apps, Machines, and Volumes, so an AI-native user can drive the platform programmatically. The vendor also says 'the API you start with is the API you keep.' Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, which limits machine-readable discovery but does not contradict the documented API. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use, and evidence of API coverage beyond Apps/Machines/Volumes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.
Fly Machines are fast-launching VMs with a simple REST API.
The API you start with is the API you keep.
